headline: Suzuki Motor Corporation files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations for Bharat Seats Limited
sum: Suzuki Motor Corporation has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE under the SEBI Takeover Code, signalling a material acquisition of shares in Bharat Seats Limited, a tier-1 automotive seating supplier.
detail: Suzuki Motor Corporation submitted a disclosure statement to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The regulation requires disclosure when an acquirer crosses the 25% shareholding threshold or acquires control. Bharat Seats Limited is a key supplier in India's automotive seating sector. The disclosure indicates Suzuki has either acquired or intends to acquire a material stake, triggering the mandatory takeover code framework including open offer obligations.
